title: Module pullback preserves epimorphisms and finite direct sums
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $f^*:\Mod(\mathcal O_Y)\to\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$ the pullback of modules [def-pc-module-pullback], where $\Mod(\mathcal O)$ is the category of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Then: (1) if $\varphi:\mathcal G\to\mathcal H$ is an epimorphism of $\Mod(\mathcal O_Y)$, then $f^*\varphi:f^*\mathcal G\to f^*\mathcal H$ is an epimorphism of $\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$; (2) for $\mathcal O_Y$-modules $\mathcal G_1,\dots,\mathcal G_n$ ($n\ge0$) with direct sum $\bigoplus_i\mathcal G_i$ and coprojections $\iota_i:\mathcal G_i\to\bigoplus_i\mathcal G_i$, the morphism $\bigoplus_i f^*\mathcal G_i\to f^*(\bigoplus_i\mathcal G_i)$ whose $i$-th component is $f^*(\iota_i)$ is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_X$-modules.
